title: Принцесса-волшебница Минки Момо: Держись за мечту
originalTitle: Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Yume o Dakishimete
alt: Принцесса-волшебница Минки Момо: Держись за мечту / Magical Princess Minky Momo: Hold on to Your Dreams / Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Yume wo Dakishimete Fairy Princess Minky Momo 2nd 魔法のプリンセス ミンキーモモ -夢を抱きしめて-
description: This series starts with the second Minky Momo arriving from "Marinasa", a land of dreams and magic, similar to Fenarinasa, that has sunk to the bottom of the sea. On Earth, she tries to accomplish what the first Momo couldn't, restore humanity's hopes and dreams, in order to save Fenarinasa and Marinenasa from extinction. Note: Although the structure of this series is almost the same as the one from 1982, it has a heavier story, with real-life social issues incorporated as themes in many of the episodes.

en:
This series starts with the second Minky Momo arriving from "Marinasa", a land of dreams and magic, similar to Fenarinasa, that has sunk to the bottom of the sea. On Earth, she tries to accomplish what the first Momo couldn't, restore humanity's hopes and dreams, in order to save Fenarinasa and Marinenasa from extinction. 



Note: Although the structure of this series is almost the same as the one from 1982, it has a heavier story, with real-life social issues incorporated as themes in many of the episodes.
